purpose: Teach: 車種/日本円/丸の内/新橋/読み物/スチール/ストリーム/ポータブル

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社用車の車種を電気自動車に切り替えましょう
lines.en: Let's switch our company vehicles over to electric cars.
lines.style: Decisive opening, clear authority. Clipped pace. The tone of someone who's already thought this through and is ready to move. No negotiation in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外送金の日本円換算を毎日確認します
lines.en: Understood. I'll confirm the yen conversion on overseas transfers daily.
lines.style: Quick affirmation, then a slight shift—listing the action with clarity and focus. Respectful, aligned. The energy of someone taking notes and moving to the next item.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 丸の内のセミナーに営業部から派遣します
lines.en: We'll dispatch someone from Sales to the Marunouchi seminar.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact assignment. Even pace, forward momentum. The voice of delegation without strain—someone comfortable giving clear direction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新橋の老舗との連携を進めます
lines.en: Understood. I'll move forward with connecting with the long-established shop in Shinbashi.
lines.style: Steady confirmation, then a deliberate step into the next action. Professional, engaged. The tone of someone noting a commitment and moving to fulfil it.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社員向け読み物を社内報に毎月載せましょう
lines.en: Let's run monthly staff reading pieces in the company newsletter.
lines.style: Proposal with light certainty. Moderate pace, conversational but purposeful. The suggestion of someone establishing a small culture shift, not announcing a mandate.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。倉庫のスチールラックを新調します
lines.en: Understood. I'll get new steel shelving for the warehouse.
lines.style: Direct acknowledgment, then the action stated with quiet efficiency. No flourish. The tone of someone who hears the instruction and begins the work.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 動画配信のストリームを高画質化しましょう
lines.en: Let's upgrade our video stream to high definition.
lines.style: Clear intention, steady pace. The voice of someone identifying what needs to happen next and moving the team toward it. Slight emphasis on the upgrade itself.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。会議用ポータブルプロジェクターを購入します
lines.en: Understood. I'll purchase portable projectors for meetings.
lines.style: Final confirmation, delivered with closure. Slightly slower pace on the action—it's the closing point. Professional, complete. The tone of someone signing off on a list.
